notes: The kill brag is do_gen_comm(ch, buf2, 0, SCMD_GOSSIP): global, so a player in another room hears it, and gossip records review. The real death path is driven and the killer's room, a player elsewhere and ReviewGossip are all asserted; the case fails when callbacks.BroadChat is unwired (R1/R5e/R5h).

C returns before burning number(0,20)/number(1,12) when the killer is not MOB_AGGR24, fails can_speak(ch), or is the victim. The seeded draw recorder proves all three gates burn zero brag draws, and the AGGR24 case is asserted on BragMessage itself (R3/R5h).

attitude_loot's call site is outside the !IS_NPC(victim) arm, so a mobile victim is looted and bragged about too. The real mob-death path asserts the loot line and, with the 1-in-21 gate forced, the mob-victim brag; removing the mob-branch call site fails it (R1/R5e/R5h).
All mob prototypes point at dummy_mob.player_specials, so NPC killers share one counter. Two distinct NPC killers produce Kill number 1 then 2, and either reads the updated value (R1/R3/R5e/R5g/R5h).

The live death owner reaches the attitude-loot path; the exact two room junk acts, order, and corpse/inventory result are asserted by TestAttitudeLootCorpseOrder. The two NPC TO_CHAR sites remain session-lifecycle blocked (R1/R3/R5e/R5h).
Case 5 needs an evil killer AND a non-evil victim, and case 1's possessive is HSHR(victim) in the port's sex encoding (0=male, 1=female, 2=neutral). Both fail on a one-at-a-time revert (R1/R4/R5h).

A mobile's do_say is an act to the room, not a message to itself (MobInstance.SendMessage is a no-op). Both say arms are driven through the real hunt step and the room's bytes are asserted; the mobile receives nothing (R1/R5h).

The tells are do_tell with the prey's name prepended as the target argument. The real hunt step delivers through perform_tell, so the prey's line and GET_LAST_TELL are C's; hand-formatting the line loses the reply target and fails the case (R1/R5h).

The gossip and auction arms are global and the gossip records review; the shout is zone limited. Case 4's text is "I hear %s thinks %s's bad." with HSSH. Room-only delivery, a missing zone filter or the invented "they're bad" text each fail a case (R1/R4/R5h).

The legacy VNum adapter's say, emote, gossip, tell, shout and auction cases now call the same helpers the native mobile commands use; its hand-built say/tell/emote lines are gone. Reverting the emote case to a hand-built room line fails it (R4/R5c/R5h).

C defines the black/red undead knight and mickey taunt bodies, but assign_mobiles() contains no ASSIGNMOB entry for these functions; no player-visible special call reaches their output. The Go tests pin preserved text only and are not C-surface proofs (R2/R4/R5e).

The con-seller's tell keeps its room-light-aware PERS rendering, which the shared act engine cannot express, but assigns perform_tell's reply target like C's do_tell; dropping the assignment fails the case (R1/R5e/R5h).

do_get("all corpse") runs perform_get_from_container for the gold pile, so the room sees "$n gets $p from $P." for the money object the way it already did for carried items; the pile's missing ITEM_WEAR_TAKE bit made the port skip it silently (R1/R5c/R5e).
